title: Writing before the block
statement: Let $\sigma:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$ be a bit sequence, let $i\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\beta$ be a finite bit string. At every position $v<i$, writing $\beta$ starting at position $i$ leaves the bit at $v$ equal to $\sigma(v)$.
hypotheses_covered: $\sigma$ is a bit sequence indexed by the natural numbers
